WITH race_averages AS (
  SELECT c.country, r.raceId, AVG(ds.wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  JOIN driverStandings ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId
), country_averages AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM race_averages
  GROUP BY country
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM country_averages
), above_overall AS (
  SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins
  FROM country_averages ca
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.avg_wins
), group_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM above_overall
)
SELECT a.country,
       a.avg_wins,
       a.avg_wins - o.avg_wins AS above_overall_average,
       a.avg_wins - g.avg_wins AS above_group_average
FROM above_overall a
CROSS JOIN overall o
CROSS JOIN group_average g
WHERE a.avg_wins > g.avg_wins
ORDER BY a.country;
